prompt: Which generation of Pokemon games did Pokemon Yellow belong to?
response: Pokémon Yellow: Special Pikachu Edition belongs to the first generation of Pokémon games. It was released as a special edition of the original Pokémon Red and Green (later Blue in international markets) for the Game Boy. The game was released in Japan in 1998 and later in North America and Europe. It features a unique starting Pikachu that follows the player around and is designed to appeal to fans of the Pokémon anime series.
